message: You know that feeling when you finally get your act together? I had a moment like that last week. I was cooking dinner and realized I hadn't checked the smoke alarms in ages. So, I climbed up on a chair and gave them a little love — turns out, one was beeping for a fresh battery. It was such a small thing, but it felt good to be the prepared one for once. Have you had any little wins in home safety lately?
